## What it is
Shared utilities for RAG orchestration services. Provides readable logging, optional OpenTelemetry observability, and a Dragonfly/Redis cache client for inter-service data sharing.

## Current capabilities
- Readable Logging (Milvus-style format for terminals and Grafana)
- OpenTelemetry Observability (optional OTLP export)
- Dragonfly/Redis Client (uses DRAGONFLY_HOST/PORT/Ttl environment variables)

## Maturity
Actively maintained with version 2.0.0 released 2025-12-31.
